title: MADR without the global Leader
intervention: No Leader API or global guidance; each Worker receives only its own first-three code recommendations filtered to active parameters.
preserve_and_boundaries: The Leader is removed by configuration, not through an API failure or the Leader fallback. Round 1 evaluates the default center; later rounds are Worker search rounds.
shared_execution: Shared hydrological executor, evaluation period, legal ranges and precision, phase locks except where explicitly ablated, same-background acceptance, center-reference reuse, retry/fallback policy, final confirmation and measured usage accounting remain active.
activation: Explicit ablations/run_ablation.py only; ordinary entry points remain unchanged.
